name: ai-accounts
title: AI Accounts
description: See Claude Code and Codex quota for every account and switch accounts with one key
author: kejun_albert_ying

commands.name: accounts
commands.title: AI Accounts
commands.subtitle: Claude + Codex
commands.description: Show remaining quota for all Claude and Codex accounts and suggest which one to use

commands.name: stats
commands.title: AI Usage Statistics
commands.subtitle: Claude + Codex
commands.description: Lifetime token usage across Claude Code and Codex, from local logs

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: AI Accounts Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Claude + Codex
commands.description: Show active-account headroom in the menu bar and switch accounts from there

commands.name: switch-account
commands.title: Switch AI Account
commands.description: Perform a Claude or Codex account switch requested from the AI Accounts list or menu bar

preferences.name: cswapPath
preferences.title: claude-swap Executable
preferences.description: Absolute path to cswap (claude-swap). A leading ~ is expanded.

preferences.name: autoAddClaudeLogins
preferences.title: Claude Logins
preferences.label: Automatically track new Claude Code logins
preferences.description: When Claude Code is signed in to an account claude-swap does not track, add it (cswap add) so it shows up and can be switched to

preferences.name: codexbarPath
preferences.title: CodexBar CLI
preferences.description: Absolute path to the codexbar CLI

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI
preferences.description: Absolute path to the codex CLI (used to stop and start the app-server daemon around a switch)

preferences.name: codexSwitchMode
preferences.title: Codex Switching
preferences.description: Experimental direct mode rewrites ~/.codex/auth.json like CodexBar's System Account menu, stops and starts the Codex app-server daemon, and interrupts running Codex turns.

preferences.name: afterSwitchCommand
preferences.title: After-switch Command
preferences.description: Run /bin/sh -c after a successful or unknown-outcome switch, for example to refresh a status bar. Sets AI_ACCOUNTS_PROVIDER (claude|codex), AI_ACCOUNTS_ACCOUNT (target label), and AI_ACCOUNTS_RESULT (succeeded|noop|unknown).

preferences.name: switchThreshold
preferences.title: Suggest Switching Below
preferences.description: Suggest another account when the active account's remaining quota drops below this

preferences.name: includeScopedWindows
preferences.title: Suggestions
preferences.label: Count model-scoped limits (e.g. Fable only)
preferences.description: Include per-model weekly limits when computing an account's headroom

preferences.name: expiringQuotaAdvice
preferences.label: Advise using quota that resets soon
preferences.description: Suggest spending an account whose weekly quota resets within 24 hours

preferences.name: excludeFromSuggestions
preferences.title: Never Suggest
preferences.description: Comma-separated emails or labels that suggestions must never target (you can still switch to them manually)

preferences.name: menuBarValue
preferences.title: Menu Bar Shows
preferences.description: What the menu bar title shows for each provider's active account

preferences.name: percentMode
preferences.title: Show Percentages As
preferences.description: Show quota as percent remaining (default) or percent used
